title: LinkSearch
shortDescription: Search Linkwarden bookmarks with optional rerank or decision-model sorting.
description: Search links saved in Linkwarden directly from Command Palette and open results in your browser. Configure your Linkwarden server, access token, and maximum result count. Optionally reorder results using a compatible Rerank API or a decision model through System One, OpenAI Decisions, OpenRouter Decisions, or compatible gateways. OpenAI uses relevance scoring; OpenRouter and System One support per-item relevance and candidate choice. Supports English and Simplified Chinese, with automatic interface language selection. Requires a Linkwarden instance and access token; optional ranking requires a separately configured service.
